TWO real implementation bugs were found and fixed during testing, both changing the frozen definition from its first draft: (1) the stop was originally a fixed VWAP+/-3-sigma band level, which landed on the wrong side of entry for ~17% of signals when a fast 1-minute move closed well past the 2-sigma trigger -- fixed by anchoring the stop to ENTRY (always exactly 1 sigma away) instead of a fixed band; (2) a small remaining fraction of signals had sigma small enough that entry and stop collapsed to the same value after 2-decimal rounding (a zero-risk signal, same failure class as detect_fvg_entry.py's earlier zero-risk-signal fix) -- fixed by skipping and continuing to watch rather than returning a degenerate signal.
